rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Judge-owned: the five-entry Module 5 pre-read block states no floor, and its walk-away framing lives only on the receiving side of the gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This passage (L68-82) sits outside the pinned diff — the diff's only Prework-region edit is L14 — and is unchanged from what the current, live body still reads. L70 reads 'Optional. Start with the first.', naming a real 10-minute compliant path (Mollick). But L74, 'The rest point at the same surprise,' still presents the remaining four entries as one set, so a student who stops after Mollick has no explicit signal that this was the intended floor rather than a partial answer. Separately: the framing that makes ~64-69 minutes of optional reading make sense — that it is sized for the dead time inside the un-watched M4 send-off — is stated only on the RECEIVING side of the gap, in `learn-from-the-test.md`'s own Prework (line 10, re-read live this session, verbatim: 'Optional prep while it's still running: read Ethan Mollick..., the one to start with;...'). A student closing THIS module meets the five-entry block with no such frame; they only meet the frame after the gap has passed, in the next module's own Prework. HARM: a student taking 'Optional. Start with the first.' at face value either stops after one entry with no confirmation that was the intended floor, or works through all five without knowing they were sized for wait-time the student may not actually have (the send-off can finish before the next session starts). Neither outcome blocks the module — the maintainer's own accept-notes at L96 and L98 explicitly defend the five-entry count and the Mollick-first lede against trimming — but those notes address entry count and lede order, not the missing floor/frame statement, so they do not discharge this finding. ALREADY TRACKED: `pre-cohort-todos.md` line 57 carries this exact finding, verbatim, under the heading 'The M4→M5 reading list is priced for the wrong side of the gap,' with the same harm and the same proposed fix, and its own firing condition. This row confirms that tracked item is still accurate against the CURRENT, unchanged body — it is not a newly discovered defect, and should be read as a live confirmation, not a duplicate log entry.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: One added clause in the L70 lede naming that these entries are sized for the wait while the send-off runs (or for later, at leisure) and that Mollick alone is a complete answer if that's all the gap allows — matches the fix already named at `pre-cohort-todos.md:57`. Requires cutting no entry and demoting no lede order, so it doesn't conflict with the L98 accept-note.
